title: UP Police Constable Result 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board
postName: Constable Civil Police & Equivalent Posts – Direct Recruitment 2025
vacancyDetails: 32,679 Constable (Civil Police) and equivalent posts under UPPRPB Direct Recruitment 2025
qualification: 10+2 (Intermediate) from a recognized board as per UPPRPB Constable notification
ageLimit: As per UP Police Constable 2025 notification (relaxations as per UP Govt rules)
applicationFee: As per UPPRPB online fee rules (category-wise)
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Document Verification / PST → Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Medical → Final Merit
documentsRequired: Registration number & password/DOB for login; educational certificates, domicile, category certificate, photo ID for DV stages
howToApply:
1. Visit https://uppbpb.gov.in
2. Open Results / Constable Result 2026 link
3. Login with registration credentials or download merit list PDF
4. Check roll number / name and download scorecard if available
5. Note DV/PST schedule and keep documents ready
shortDescription: UPPRPB has declared UP Police Constable Result 2026 on 31 July 2026 for 32,679 posts. Written exam held on 8–10 June 2026. Check merit list at uppbpb.gov.in.
content:
The Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) has declared the UP Police Constable Result 2026 for Direct Recruitment of 32,679 Constable (Civil Police) and equivalent posts.

The written examination was conducted across Uttar Pradesh on 08, 09 and 10 June 2026. Provisional answer key was released around 20 June 2026, and the result was published on 31 July 2026.

Next stages

  • Document Verification (DV) / Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
  • Medical examination and final merit

Candidates should download the official result / merit list only from uppbpb.gov.in and prepare documents for the physical stages as per the schedule notified by the board.
